Q1. Four people (Alex, Bob, Carol, and Dave) come across a bridge at night. The bridge can only hold two people at a time, and they only have one flashlight (crossing the bridge without flashlight is impossible). The four people walk at different speeds: Alex takes 1 minute to cross the bridge, Bob takes 2 minutes, Carol takes 5 minutes, and Dave takes 10 minutes. When two people cross the bridge together, they must go at the slower person's pace. They have only 17 minutes before a train passes under the bridge, and they need to get to the other side before that happens. Your task is to find the shortest time in which all four people can safely cross the bridge. Explain your steps. [C109.1 (Understanding), 2 Marks]

Q2. You have been asked to design an automated face recognition system. However, the exact requirements are not yet clear. Can we use waterfall SDLC model for this particular system? Justify your answer. [C109.1 (Understanding), 1 Marks]

Q3. Write a program to input a positive integer from user. Then exchange its ith and jth digits. The value of i and j should be given as input by the user. Please note all the digits in the number are supposed to be non-zero.
Example: N= 3246159
i= 2, j=5
ith digit is 5 and jth digit is 4
Exchanged number is: 3256149 [C109.4 (Applying), 5 Marks]

Q4. Write a C program to automate the process of apparel label generation for Men's trousers. The program should take inputs of standard Hip and Length in inches. The program should identify the standard apparel Label Size based on the table using Switch-case control as given below.

| Hip (in inches) | Length (in inches) | Label Size |
| 30 | 38 | LARGE |
| 32 | 39 | XL |
| 34 | 40 | XXL |

Finally, the output should display the appropriate label of Hip, Length, and Label Size.
Sample label format generated is given as below.

Hip : 32
Length : 39
Label Size : XL
For any other input display the message "Wrong Input".
[C109.2 (Understanding), 3 Marks]

Q5. You are asked to draw a flowchart that determines a person's income tax based on their income and other criteria. The tax calculation is based on the following rules:

| Income | Tax |
| Less than 700000 | 0 |
| Greater than 700000 and less than equal to 1000000 | 10% |
| Greater than 1000000 and less than equal to 1500000 | 30000 + 20% of amount exceeding |
| Greater than 1500000 | 130000 + 30% of amount exceeding |

Additionally, if the total tax of an individual exceeds 30,000 then an additional 5% education cess tax is applied on their tax.
[C109.1 (Understanding), 3 Marks]

Q6. Write a C program to print a butterfly pattern based on the height of the butterfly provided by the user. Your program must ensure that the height entered by the user must be an even positive integer.
Enter height: 10
